The '''Dibrook system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dibrook]].
